title: Finance settings
description: Operator settings of the finance module; rendered into finance.yaml by the chart. Secrets are never settings (they come from the module's Secret).

base_currency.description: Reporting currency. Every document stores its FX rate to it; change it only before the first invoice.

payment_instructions.description: Default 'how to pay' text printed on invoices (bank details, payment link text).

public_base_url.description: Prefix of the signed invoice links, for example https://billing.example.com (no trailing slash). Only /public/invoices/* should be routed to the internet.

payment_provider.description: fake is for development only; real adapters are separate modules.

retention_years.description: Years financial records are kept after their own date; 0 keeps them forever. Check your jurisdiction: this is not legal advice.

audit_retention_days.description: At least 365, or 0 to keep everything.

trust_proxy.description: Use the right-most X-Forwarded-For entry (set by Traefik) as the client address for rate limiting. Enable only behind a proxy that appends the client address.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Requests per API token per minute; 0 disables.

auth_failures_per_minute.description: Failed authentications and bad invoice links per client address per minute before the address is throttled; 0 disables. Valid credentials are never throttled by this.

webhook_url.description: Where signed finance events are POSTed. Needs CAN_FINANCE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
